portal_hypertension.title: Predicting esophageal varices in cirrhosis: diagnostic utility of MR elastography and dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI.
portal_hypertension.authors: Singwicha T, Chansaengpetch S, Tanpowpong N
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：MRI 的进步为 EV 预测提供了非侵入性方法。 临床提示：肝硬化常常并发门静脉高压导致的食管静脉曲张（EV）。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Liver cirrhosis is often complicated by esophageal varices (EVs) due to portal hypertension. Advances in MRI offer non-invasive methods for EV prediction. This study evaluates the diagnostic performance of liver stiffness (LS) and spleen stiffness (SS) from MR elastography (MRE) and EV visualization on dynamic contrast-enhanced (DCE)-MRI in cirrhotic individuals. This retrospective cross-sectional study included upper abdominal MRI studies from cirrhotic participants who underwent esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) between February 2022 and July 2023. LS and SS from MRE were measured, while two radiologists independently assessed EV presence on DCE-MRI. Diagnostic performance was evaluated usi...

portal_hypertension.title: Long-Term Continuous Terlipressin Infusion Improves Cardiac Reserve in Patients With Decompensated Cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.journal: Clinical gastroenterology and hepatology : the official clinical practice journal of the American Gastroenterological Association
portal_hypertension.authors: Terbah R, Koshy AN, Majumdar A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：心功能不全是肝肾综合征发病的关键因素，特利加压素是推荐的一线治疗药物。 临床提示：本研究探讨长期服用特利加压素是否可以改善失代偿性肝硬化中观察到的亚临床心功能障碍。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Cardiac dysfunction is a key factor in the pathogenesis of hepatorenal syndrome, for which terlipressin is the recommended first-line treatment. This study investigates whether long-term terlipressin can ameliorate the subclinical cardiac dysfunction observed in decompensated cirrhosis. Twenty-two patients with decompensated cirrhosis and ascites enrolled in a prospective study of home continuous terlipressin infusion were included. Cardiac function was assessed using dobutamine stress echocardiogram before and after 12 weeks of terlipressin.
